entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I need to return my VeloBand Pulse. I'm just... very disappointed with it.
I'm certainly sorry to hear you're disappointed. To make sure I get you to the right place, can I ask what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's supposed to be a heart rate monitor, but it doesn't monitor my heart rate. It keeps dropping the signal. Honestly, the product feels like complete garbage.

I understand how frustrating that would be. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I can try to walk you through a few troubleshooting steps, or I can transfer you directly to our technical support team who are experts with the new Pulse model.

Oh, I really don't have time for all that. I've already tried restarting it. I've been a loyal customer for a long time, and I just feel so let down. I just want money back for this, please. I need a refund.

I understand you'd prefer a return over troubleshooting. I just need to check the purchase date to confirm the eligibility. One moment... Okay, I see the VeloBand was delivered to you 20 days ago, on December 15th.
Let me pull up our return policy for you... Okay, I'm looking at our knowledge base right now. It shows here that all VeloFit items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Since you are well within that 90-day window, I can absolutely go ahead and process this return for you. No problem at all.
Oh, really? That's... such a relief. Thank you. I was worried this was going to be a whole thing. I really needed that money back.

Of course. I'm happy to get this sorted out for you. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email address on file right now. Just pack the VeloBand back in its box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be processed to your original payment method in 3-5 business days.
That's perfect. Thank you so much, Charlie. I really appreciate your help.
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
